field_map.t: unix sec UTC: OUR receive time, unless ft=1 (then the fix's own time). The fix is `sp` seconds older than a receive-time stamp
field_map.al: altitude m: barometric (pressure altitude) when the aircraft sent one, else geometric; see ak and x.ab/x.ag for which
field_map.v: ground speed m/s, rounded (omitted when unknown)
field_map.h: track over ground deg (broadcast `track`; not the nose heading)
field_map.rg: registration/tail number as broadcast (schema v2 2026-08-08, additive; omitted when not broadcast)
field_map.integrity block: schema v3 2026-08-11, additive: ni np nv si st rc gv sd nb av pt ml tb kla klo kb sp pv — decode table in server/datacoreArchive.ts aircraftIntegrityFields (sp = position age s at receive; pv = provider)
field_map.x: schema v4 2026-10-14, additive: delta-encoded intent/state block, keyframe per aircraft per hour file (ag/ab altitudes ft, br/gr vertical rates ft/min, rl roll deg, ...) — format in server/aircraftIntent.ts
field_map.ag: schema v5 2026-11-16, additive: geometric (GNSS) altitude m above the WGS84 ellipsoid; written only on lines whose x block does not carry it
field_map.vr: schema v5: broadcast vertical rate m/s (0.1, + climbing); written only on lines whose x block carries no rate
field_map.vs: schema v5: which rate vr is — b barometric, g geometric; omitted when not told
field_map.ak: schema v5: which altitude al is — b barometric, g geometric; omitted when not recorded (lines with an x block say it there)
field_map.ft: schema v5: 1 = t is the fix's own time (lines written by archiveAircraftAt: trace backfill and the selected-aircraft lane); omitted = receive time

confidence_model: as-broadcast ADS-B; no inference applied at archive time
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
